name: Team model: she leads and works with you, no commands
body: Dean: the player and the companion are equals, not a commander and a follower, so Q (call), E (wait) and F (send) go. The partner follows a level's ordered `team_beat` markers instead: she walks to the next beat when you are near (or ahead), does what it says (stand on a plate, crouch for a boost, pull a lever, be seen) and moves on when its release rule says so (you are near her, you are at a named spot, a channel is on, or a time has passed). F stays as the player's own use key for levers.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: No Q, E or send key and no command text anywhere
She goes first and waits for you, hopping when you are far behind
Beats can hold a plate until you stand on the far plate, so you let her through
